sections.heading: Architecture
sections.text: A React and TypeScript static site hosted on GitHub Pages. The globe uses Three.js. Public profile data is stored in version-controlled JSON and compiled into a MiniSearch retrieval index.

sections.heading: Assistant
sections.text: The assistant runs in the browser and retrieves public records before answering. Live model requests use the configured proxy; without a model, the site labels its preset offline responses. The English and Chinese editions share record IDs and have separate text and retrieval indexes.
